sdk: prime CLI 0.9.1 + api.primeintellect.ai (headless; self-run prime-rl 0.7.0 on on-demand pods)

orena_sft.blocked_reason: prime-rl 0.7.0 (the pod image) rejects [model.vlm] for SFT: the SFT data path is renderer-only and tokenizes text-only message dicts client-side ('renderer-only SFT does not support VLMs yet'). GitHub main has removed this check and supports VLM SFT, so this is version drift, not a hard platform limit.

orena_rl.note: Feasible on 0.7.0 (the RL config supports [model.vlm]; rollout renders through vLLM which handles images natively). Prime Intellect can RL Qwen3.5-9B directly, unlike Fireworks which is limited to qwen3-vl-8b-instruct.

findings: VLM SFT is blocked by version drift: the pod image ships prime-rl 0.7.0 whose SFT path is renderer-only and rejects [model.vlm] ('renderer-only SFT does not support VLMs yet'); GitHub main supports VLM SFT. This is the mirror-image of Fireworks' gap (Fireworks cannot RL qwen3p5-9b; Prime Intellect 0.7.0 cannot SFT a VLM but CAN RL it).

GoEmotions RL did not learn (final micro-F1 0.035, jaccard_curve flat/noisy): a fresh Qwen3-0.6B base model + Jaccard reward over 64 steps is not enough signal, versus Fireworks' 0.175 -> 0.377 on 5000 prompts.

Qwen3 thinking-mode is the dominant RL footgun: with enable_thinking=true (default) every completion ran to max_completion_length (Truncation 100%, reward 0). Disabling it in [orchestrator.renderer] (enable_thinking=false) fixed truncation to ~0-3%. SageMaker hit the same issue and did not disable it (reward stayed 0); Prime Intellect disabled it.
GRPO has no KL term on prime-rl 0.7.0: GRPOAlgoConfig has no kl_beta field (only length_penalty). The reference's KL beta 0.04 has no equivalent knob.

GRPO zero-advantage post-batch filter (enforce=true by default) drops every group whose rollouts share a reward — the common case for a fresh model — and aborts the run with '10 consecutive empty train batches'. Overriding it to enforce=false lets training proceed.

LoRA checkpoint bug: default save_adapter_separately=false silently strips the adapter at checkpoint; the saved model.safetensors is the un-fine-tuned base. save_adapter_separately=true + merge (W' = W + (B@A)*alpha/r) is required.

Single-GPU RL needs CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='0,0' to satisfy the launcher's disjoint-GPU check, and vLLM's gpu_memory_utilization must be lowered (0.9 -> 0.6) because the trainer and inference server share the physical GPU.

On-demand pods bill per-hour, not per-job, so per-experiment cost is an estimate; a provisioned-but-unused H200 pod sat idle at $4.50/hr (blocked by the VLM SFT version drift) and accumulated $15.51 of the ~$20 total pod spend.

notes.compute: All runs are self-run prime-rl 0.7.0 on on-demand pods (headless CLI + SSH), not the hosted 'training runs' surface. GoEmotions SFT ran on an A100 40GB ($1.99/hr); GoEmotions RL on an A10 24GB (~$1.24/hr); an H200 141GB ($4.50/hr) was provisioned for ORena but sat idle (VLM SFT blocked).
notes.cost: estimated_cost_usd is approximate: pods bill per-hour and a pod can host multiple attempts. Wall-time for SFT is estimated from the 100-step loss curve; for RL from the trainer step timestamps (64 steps in ~14 min). A10 pod total was $4.16 (includes 3 failed RL launches + debugging); H200 total $15.51 (idle).
notes.data: dataset_size is the small-run subset (800 train / 200 dev GoEmotions), not the full canonical set (43,410). This is a recorded D6 deviation (shrink data volume to fit a small budget).
notes.kl_beta: shared.rl_kl_beta=0.04 is the reference target only; prime-rl 0.7.0 GRPO has no KL-to-reference term, so no KL was actually applied.
notes.goemotions_rl_metrics: final_jaccard/final_micro_f1 are greedy held-out dev scores (200 rows, thinking disabled). jaccard_curve is the per-step mean training reward (sampled rollouts, Jaccard), 64 steps. start_micro_f1 was not measured (no base-model greedy eval); the base model scores ~0.02-0.035.
notes.orena: ORena SFT is BLOCKED and ORena RL NOT_STARTED. A H200 pod was provisioned for both; it is terminated to stop idle billing. ORena RL is feasible on 0.7.0 and remains the outstanding leg.
